text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I was practicing for a performance earlier…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: But the speakers had been set to the wrong volume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I was standing near them, so now my head and ears are ringing, and the ringing won't go away…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Bigger is always better… except when it comes to decibel levels, I suppose… Owww…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Being exposed to such loud sounds has given Hishi Akebono a really bad headache…
